verdict.rationale: Meilisearch is a search engine and database that serves data to AI clients. Consuming tools from external MCP servers belongs to the agent or MCP-client role, so this axis does not fit this kind of product. The pack documents only a native MCP server at POST /mcp, which is server-side and cannot be credited toward this client-side story. Nothing shows Meilisearch itself connecting to or calling tools from other MCP servers.
